authorization.basis: Option F passed every frozen plant gate; active project goal authorizes continued VISION-aligned synthetic work.
authorization.scope: one synthetic-only label-free babbling, local-forward, and inverse-closure candidate

research_question: Can a bounded winner-local forward model learned through label-free babbling invert unseen targets on the five-gesture expanded-band plant while preserving identity, acoustic consequences, and identifiable motor structure?

plant_and_sensory.plant: exact frozen Option F factorized five-gesture plant
plant_and_sensory.sensory_transform: analytic transfer log magnitude, mean center, L2 normalize

babbling.transition: interpolate so no coordinate changes by more than 0.20 per 25 ms hop; interpolation states do not update the learner
babbling.f0_assignment: cycle 90,110,140,180 Hz by endpoint ordinal; F0 does not change the tract sensory target

local_forward_model.winner: minimum Euclidean motor distance; lower index breaks ties
local_forward_model.winner_update: accumulate XTX, XTY, and count only for the winning prototype
local_forward_model.prediction: winner affine output, mean center, L2 normalize

forward_gate.distance: Euclidean distance between unit sensory vectors

baselines.nearest_prototype: winner affine intercept without local slope
baselines.persistence: previous held-out target sensory; neutral for first

inverse_targets.selection: unique minimum relative canonical F1/F2/F3 RMSE from the inverse target pool; lower Halton index breaks ties
inverse_targets.trials: five target motors crossed with four F0 conditions

inverse_search.initialization: prototype center whose stored intercept minimizes sensory distance; effort then lower index break ties
inverse_search.step_rule: halve all steps after each complete round
inverse_search.acceptance: strict total-loss improvement; ties retain current state
inverse_search.sensory_loss: half Euclidean distance between unit 30-value vectors

equivalence_verification.plant_jacobian: central finite difference of expanded sensory at target motor with delta 0.005; one-sided at bounds

decision_rule: Implement and checkpoint exactly this candidate before opening held-out or target ranges. Execute once. Any failed forward or closure gate is retained without changing points, model size, ridge, representation, loss, search, thresholds, or targets.
promotion_boundary: A full pass is synthetic-only evidence for a bounded shared motor/sensory representation on this simplified plant. It does not promote H4, establish infant or anatomical fidelity, or authorize recorded audio.
